summary_1line: Bhishma tells a tale of a Chandala cursed by contact with stolen Brahmin cattle’s milk, illustrating severe karmic consequences and redemption through self‑sacrifice for a Brahmana.

image_candidates.scene_text: A dust-covered Chandala anxiously tries to wipe drops of milk from his body while dogs and donkeys wander around him on the roadside.
Stolen cows shake their bodies as milk sprays outward, symbolically bringing ruin upon the king and his descendants.
The Chandala throws himself into the chaos of battle to protect a Brahmana’s wealth, offering his life as a final sacrifice.
